adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces a new admin embedding endpoint and payload shape that depends on the serializer/store hydration contract: `EmbeddingSerializer` uses `has_many :embeddable_hosts, ... embed: :ids`, which will emit an `embeddable_host_ids` field plus sideloaded `embeddable_hosts`. The store hydration logic was changed to support plural `_ids` in `_hydrateEmbedded` (`/(.+)\_id(s?)$/` and `obj[self.pluralize(subType)] = ...`). However, there is no test exercising `GET /admin/customize/embedding` (or the Ember route `this.store.find('embedding')` + adapter path) to verify the payload can actually be hydrated into `embedding.embeddable_hosts`. The only plural-hydration coverage added/updated is via the synthetic fruit/color fixture in `store-test.js.es6` and `create-pretender.js.es6`, not the real `embedding`/`embeddable-host` chain.
